sep.name: Finite verb with its separated particle put back

transforms.name: declined
transforms.description: Adjective with a case ending (schöne, schönen, schöner, schönes, schönem; leise, dunkle, teure, hohe).

transforms.name: comparative
transforms.description: Comparative of an adjective (schöner, älter, größer, dunkler, teurer, besser, mehr).

transforms.name: superlative
transforms.description: Superlative of an adjective, which takes an ending (der schönste, am schönsten, älteste, größte, beste, meiste).

transforms.name: present (ich, er)
transforms.description: Present tense of a modal verb or wissen, first and third person singular (ich/er kann, darf, muss, mag, soll, will, weiß).

transforms.name: present (ich)
transforms.description: Present tense, first person singular (ich mache, gehe, sammle, wandere). The same form is the subjunctive I of ich and er (er habe, es gebe) and the imperative with -e (mache!).

transforms.name: present (du)
transforms.description: Present tense, second person singular (du machst, arbeitest, sammelst, gibst, fährst, kannst).

transforms.name: present (du, er)
transforms.description: Present tense, second and third person singular of a strong verb whose stem ends in s, ß or z (du/er liest, isst, lässt, stößt, wächst).

transforms.name: present (er, ihr)
transforms.description: Present tense, third person singular, which is also the second person plural and its imperative (er macht, arbeitet, gibt, fährt; ihr macht, macht!).

transforms.name: present (wir, sie)
transforms.description: Present tense, first and third person plural, written like the infinitive (wir fangen ... an, sie kommen ... zurück; wir sind, sie sind).

transforms.name: imperative (du)
transforms.description: Imperative, second person singular, without -e (mach!, komm!, gib!, nimm!, sieh!, lies!, sei!).

transforms.name: past participle
transforms.description: Past participle (gemacht, gearbeitet, eingekauft, gegangen, angefangen, verstanden, bekommen).

transforms.name: present participle
transforms.description: Present participle (machend, lächelnd, wandernd).

transforms.name: past (ich, er)
transforms.description: Simple past (preterite), first and third person singular (machte, arbeitete, ging, kam, brachte, war). For weak verbs it is also the subjunctive II.

transforms.name: past (du)
transforms.description: Simple past, second person singular (machtest, gingst, fandest, warst).

transforms.name: past (wir, sie)
transforms.description: Simple past, first and third person plural (machten, gingen, kamen, waren).

transforms.name: past (ihr)
transforms.description: Simple past, second person plural (machtet, gingt, fandet, wart).

transforms.name: subjunctive I
transforms.description: Subjunctive I (Konjunktiv I) of du and ihr (du machest, ihr machet), and the forms of sein (er sei, sie seien).

transforms.name: subjunctive II (ich, er)
transforms.description: Subjunctive II (Konjunktiv II) of a strong or mixed verb, first and third person singular (ginge, käme, wäre, hätte, würde, brächte, könnte).

transforms.name: subjunctive II (du)
transforms.description: Subjunctive II, second person singular (gingest, kämst, wärst, hättest, würdest).

transforms.name: subjunctive II (wir, sie)
transforms.description: Subjunctive II, first and third person plural (gingen, kämen, wären, hätten, würden).

transforms.name: subjunctive II (ihr)
transforms.description: Subjunctive II, second person plural (ginget, kämt, wärt, hättet, würdet).

transforms.name: zu-infinitive
transforms.description: Infinitive with zu between a separable prefix and the verb (anzurufen, aufzustehen, kennenzulernen).

transforms.name: separated prefix
transforms.description: A separable prefix at the end of the clause, put back in front of its verb (kommt morgen an. -> ankommt -> ankommen; Hör auf! -> aufhören).

transforms.name: plural
transforms.description: Plural of a noun (Tage, Bäume, Kinder, Häuser, Mütter, Äpfel, Blumen, Frauen, Lehrerinnen, Autos, Ergebnisse, Museen, Themen).

transforms.name: genitive
transforms.description: Genitive singular (des Vaters, des Tages, des Hauses, des Namens, Peters, Deutschlands).

transforms.name: plural
transforms.description: Plural in -s of a noun that ends in a consonant (Hotels, Jobs, Teams).

transforms.name: dative plural
transforms.description: Dative plural, the plural with -n added (den Tagen, den Kindern, den Äpfeln).

transforms.name: contraction
transforms.description: A preposition contracted with the article (am = an dem, im = in dem, zum = zu dem, zur = zu der, ins = in das).

transforms.name: -'s (es)
transforms.description: A verb with es or das reduced to 's (gibt's = gibt es, macht's = macht es).

transforms.name: nominalization
transforms.description: Noun formed from a verb

transforms.name: -bar
transforms.description: -able adjective from a verb

transforms.name: negative
transforms.description: Negation

transforms.name: -heit
transforms.description:
1. Converts an adjective into a noun and usually denotes an abstract quality of the adjectival root. It is often equivalent to the English suffixes -ness, -th, -ty, -dom:
	 schön (“beautiful”) + -heit → Schönheit (“beauty”)
	 neu (“new”) + -heit → Neuheit (“novelty”)
2. Converts concrete nouns into abstract nouns:
	 Kind (“child”) + -heit → Kindheit (“childhood”)
	 Christ (“Christian”) + -heit → Christenheit (“Christendom”)
